why_v2_cannot_produce_today: No V2-native Bitcoin on-chain feed ingestor exists.

Legacy V3 schema marks onchain_btc.optional=true (see v2/legacy_owned_runtime/rl/obs_schema.py _build_schema_v3). It is therefore optional for legacy inference and not required for V2 paper inference.
V2 has no on-chain data source in v2:* Redis.

v2_implementation_outline_if_approved: Extend full_observation_builder.onchain_btc to project from new v2:market keys.
Add focused tests + Codex review pair.

rationale_for_optionality: Legacy V3 obs_schema declares onchain_btc with optional=True. This makes it explicitly skippable for checkpoint compatibility purposes, so V2 can keep the 15 dims explicit-missing without breaking the V3 shape contract.
operator_decision_options: APPROVE_EXTERNAL_BTC_ONCHAIN_FEED: provide credentials and V2 ingestor scope.
DEFER_ONCHAIN_BTC: keep 15 dims explicit-missing (current default; safe under optional=True).
EXCLUDE_ONCHAIN_BTC: skip permanently and record the limitation in the operator-provided checkpoint metadata.
